integrity: The general bound follows directly from the two Birkhoff lower estimates available under symmetry and the triangle inequality. The affine-regular hexagon is proved to have symmetric Birkhoff orthogonality by an explicit norming-functional classification, and one explicit pair attains the bound for every positive parameter pair. The bundled checker verifies all facet and support certificates. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The structural upper bound assumes symmetric Birkhoff orthogonality. The exact sharpness statement is proved for the affine-regular hexagonal plane only; the result does not classify the skew constant on all Radon or polygonal planes.
title: Radon sharp bound and exact skew-orthogonality profile of the affine-regular hexagon
